# Round-trip fixtures (AR-06, FR-FMT-07)

Hand-written, **synthetic** notes (D-50). No content comes from real exports. Every file must survive parse → serialize byte-for-byte, and edits must change only the edited range.

| Folder | Files | Style |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `obsidian/` | 10 | Obsidian syntax: callouts, block IDs, sized embeds, heading/block links, tables with `\|`, list marker variants, checklists, tags, HTML, footnotes, math, `%%` comments, unknown fences, emphasis variants, setext headings, hard breaks, links in code |
| `capacities/` | 10 | Capacities export style, one folder per type |
| `notion/` | 5 | Notion export style: H1 title, property lines, 32-hex IDs, URL-encoded links |
| `tegg/` | 5 | Tegg canonical output: every MVP block type, all attribute types, query and mindmap blocks |
| `edge/` | 13 | Byte-level edge cases: empty, only frontmatter, CRLF, mixed endings, BOM, no final newline, many trailing newlines, invalid YAML, unclosed frontmatter, YAML styles, trailing whitespace, a quote ending in an empty `>` line directly followed by a paragraph (lazy continuation, found in the real Capacities export) |

Do not "fix" these files in an editor: CRLF, BOM and trailing whitespace are intentional. The **NFD file name** case is not stored here, because git on macOS converts NFD names to NFC (`core.precomposeunicode`); the FR-FMT-12 test creates an NFD-named file in a temporary folder instead. They are generated byte-exact; if one must change, edit it with a tool that preserves bytes.
